import random

def quickselect(arr: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    """Find the k-th smallest element (0-indexed) using randomized quickselect.
    Must use random pivot selection for O(n) average performance."""
    n = len(arr)
    if not 0 <= k < n:
        raise IndexError("k out of range")
    # Work on a copy to avoid mutating the caller's list
    a = list(arr)
    lo, hi = 0, n - 1
    while True:
        if lo == hi:
            return a[lo]
        # Random pivot selection for O(n) average performance
        pivot_index = random.randint(lo, hi)
        # Move pivot to end for Lomuto partition
        a[pivot_index], a[hi] = a[hi], a[pivot_index]
        pivot = a[hi]
        i = lo
        for j in range(lo, hi):
            if a[j] < pivot:
                a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
                i += 1
        a[i], a[hi] = a[hi], a[i]
        if k == i:
            return a[i]
        elif k < i:
            hi = i - 1
        else:
            lo = i + 1
</public_patch>
